parsed.justification: Against the résumé target_roles, the posting title "Senior Market Researcher, Insurance Product & Marketing" contains none of the required phrases, and the posting department "Product & Design" is not an allowed department. Against the résumé location and remote_ok, the posting location and offices show "New York, New York, United States" with "3 days of in-office work per week", which is neither Boston nor remote. The content mentions none of the résumé skills (not stated), and against experience_years it requires "5+ years of hands-on experience in market research"; condition 6 passes because the title has no excluded whole words and the content does not state contract-only, unpaid, or explicit relocation terms.

Against the résumé target_roles and exclusions, the posting title "Manager, Data Mining - Payment Integrity" contains none of the required role phrases (1) and contains the excluded whole word "Manager" (6). The posting departments value "Insurance Operations" is not an allowed department (2). Against the résumé location and remote_ok, the posting location and offices say "New York, New York, United States" with "3 days of in-office work per week" and no US-remote option (3). In the posting content, only one résumé skill appears ("Experience with SQL"), short of the two required (4), and the posting requires "4+ years experience in healthcare operations", which exceeds the résumé experience_years of 3 (5).

Against the résumé's target_roles, the posting title "Senior Data Scientist" contains none of the required role phrases (Condition 1), and the posting departments value "Data" is not an allowed department (Condition 2). Against the résumé's location and remote_ok, the posting location "New York, New York, United States" and content stating "This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule" fail the Boston-or-US-remote requirement (Condition 3). Against the résumé's experience_years, the content requires "4+ years of industry or other quantitative technical fields" (Condition 5). Condition 4 passes because the content mentions the résumé skills SQL and Python, and Condition 6 passes because the title has no excluded word and the content describes a paid, full-time role with no explicit relocation requirement.

The title and departments match target_roles ("Software Engineer", "Engineering"), but location fails: the posting is in "New York, New York, United States" and states "This is a hybrid position, you will need to live within commutable distance to our New York City office", not Boston or US remote, despite the applicant's location and remote_ok. Skills fail because the content mentions none of the applicant's ten skills (not stated). Experience fails because the content requires "7+ years of professional software engineering experience" against experience_years of 3. Exclusions fail because the title contains "Staff".

Compared with the résumé's target_roles and exclusions, the posting title "Director of Product, Provider Data Management" contains none of the required role phrases (1) and includes the excluded whole word "Director" (6). The posting's departments field lists only "Product & Design", which is not an allowed department (2). Against the résumé's location and remote_ok fields, the posting's location and offices fields give "New York, New York, United States" and the content says "This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule", which is neither Boston nor US remote (3). The posting content mentions none of the ten résumé skills (not stated) (4), and it requires "10+ years of product management experience", which exceeds the résumé's 3 experience_years (5).

Against the résumé's target_roles and exclusions, the title "Group Product Manager, Lucie Platform" contains no required role phrase (1) and includes the excluded whole word "Manager" (6); the department "Product & Design" is not an allowed department (2). Against location and remote_ok, the posting location "New York, New York, United States" and the content "based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule" mean it is neither in Boston nor remote within the US (3). The content mentions none of the résumé skills (Python, Java, TypeScript, FastAPI, React, LangGraph, RAG, PyTorch, SQL, Docker), so at least two of them are not stated (4). The content also requires "7+ years of product management experience", which exceeds the 3-year limit tied to experience_years (5).

The title "Senior Product Manager, Marketplace" matches none of the target_roles phrases (1), and it contains the excluded whole word "Manager" (6). The department "Product & Design" is not an allowed department (2), and the location "New York, New York, United States" with "requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week" is neither Boston nor remote, so it does not fit the résumé's location or remote_ok (3). Of the résumé skills, the content mentions only "SQL" (4), and its requirement of "6+ years of experience" exceeds the 3-year limit from experience_years (5).

Condition 1 fails because the posting title "Senior Analyst, Data Analytics, SIU" has none of the required role phrases from the résumé's target_roles. Condition 2 fails because the posting departments value is "Compliance", which is not an allowed department. The other conditions pass: the posting location and content say "fully remote and open to candidates residing in the U.S." (matching résumé location and remote_ok), the content mentions the résumé skills SQL and Python, it requires only "1+ years" (within experience_years of 3), and the title and content trigger none of the résumé exclusions.

Against the résumé target_roles and exclusions, the title "Director of Product, Claims Design" contains no allowed role phrase (1) and contains the excluded word "Director" (6). The departments field "Product & Design" is not an allowed department (2). Against the résumé location and remote_ok, the location "New York, New York, United States" with "3 days of in-office work per week" is neither Boston nor US remote (3). None of the ten résumé skills appear in the content, so skill matches are not stated (4), and against experience_years the content requires "10+ years of product experience" (5).

Compared against target_roles and exclusions, the posting title "Staff Security Engineer, GRC" contains none of the allowed role phrases (1) and includes the excluded word "Staff" (6), and its departments value "Security" is not an allowed department (2). The posting location and offices, "New York, New York, United States" and "New York, NY", with "requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week", match neither the résumé location of Boston, MA nor its remote_ok preference (3). Compared against the résumé skills, none of the ten skills appear in the content (not stated) (4), and the content requires "7+ years of combined experience", which exceeds the résumé experience_years of 3 (5).
